scope: Read-only disposition of the final-tag 181-versus-184 supplied-model browser count using actual artifact screenshot/PDF, recorded assertions and tagged source. No benchmark rerun or model execution.

visible_reason: A measured block was at or near the observed clock step; raw timings are retained without a summary cost.

source_policy.definition: Withhold summary costs if any successful measurement block has elapsed_ms <=0 or is below 20*observed_clock_step*1000. The status is resolution_limited only when no prediction errors were recorded. Calibration targets the larger of min_duration and 20 observed clock steps, but subsequent measured blocks are checked independently.

evidence_limit: The uploaded artifact contains no benchmark oracle JSON, raw measurement rows, measured clock-step value or generated HTML. Exact elapsed durations and the threshold comparison cannot be independently recalculated from this artifact. No particular duration, timing-jitter mechanism or budget exhaustion is inferred.
